narrative.overview: Shaky's site should feel like a credible game-studio or broadcast operator at night: deep navy atmosphere, Shaky blue as instrument lighting, and one signature motion treatment (wireframe geometry) instead of a pile of retro HUD effects.
keyCharacteristics: Deep void navy base with cool frost text
Three-step blue accent ramp: royal → sky → cyan edge
Large display headlines, heavy weight, tight tracking
Glass panels with 22px radius and hairline borders
Signature wireframe canvas geometry as primary motion

rules.name: The Logo Blue Rule
rules.body: Accent hues must stay within the existing Shaky ramp. Do not introduce purple gradients, gold fintech accents, or neon magenta.

rules.name: The Flat Stack Ban
rules.body: Do not combine vignette + grid + scanlines + grain + HUD corners + glass stacks. Pick one signature atmospheric layer plus base gradient.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Display headlines may carry a single soft glow. No gradient text.

dos: Do keep dark void navy backgrounds and the Shaky blue → cyan accent ramp.
Do treat wireframe canvas geometry as the primary atmospheric motion.
Do use glass panels sparingly for major content blocks.
Do keep copy direct and operator-toned.
donts: Don't ship generic SaaS landing patterns.
Don't sound like a creator agency pitch deck.
Don't use cyber HUD clichés: corner brackets, scanlines, fake status pings.
Don't pivot to AI editorial cream-paper layout.
Don't use neon crypto / Web3 aesthetics.
Don't stack vignette + grid + scanlines + grain + HUD + glass.
